artworks.title: Maternal Caress
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting in an upholstered chair and tightly hugging a nude, blond child in this vertical, colored print. Both have pale, peach-toned skin. The woman’s black hair is pulled back though a couple tendrils curl on her forehead. Her eyes are downcast and her pink lips parted. She wears a long, cream-white dress dotted with blush-pink, petal-like forms. One arm is under the baby’s chubby bottom and the other braces the child behind the shoulders. The baby wraps their arms around the woman’s neck so they are cheek to cheek. The chair sits in front of a bed with a boxy frame and a pillowy white mattress. The upholstery on the woman’s chair and the wallpaper behind her are patterned with coral-pink flowers and vines against butter yellow. The floor is also coral pink. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Edition de 25 épreuves Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt.”

artworks.title: Afternoon Tea Party
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint with touches of gold metallic paint on wove paper
artworks.description: Two women with pale, peachy skin sit next to a table holding a silver tray and royal-blue tea cups and saucers in this colored, vertical etching and aquatint. Faint black lines outline the women, their features, clothing, and objects in the room, and each area is filled in with a flat color. The women face each other and take up most of the composition. Both have oval faces, rounded noses, pale pink lips, and their brown hair is pulled up and back. The woman to our right leans forward as she holds up a blue plate with her right hand, closer to us. The other hand rests on the arm of her tawny-brown chair. Her dress has a petal pink bodice and long skirt with fog-white long sleeves and white fabric covering her chest and tucked into the low, rounded neckline. The other woman’s blue cap has a celery-green feather and is tied in a bow under the chin. She wears a hip-length, black cloak over a pale, sage-green dress. She looks down at the plate and holds what might be a cookie or biscuit with one hand and a cup and a dish-like saucer with the other. Her lips are downturned and her head pulled slightly back to create a double chin. She sits upright in another brown chair. In the lower right corner of the sheet, the round gray table is barely bigger than the round gray tray it holds. On it are two more cups and saucers and a silver jug, presumably holding milk. What might be another cup and saucer set or the teapot is cut off by the right edge of the paper. The rims of the cups and saucers are edged with gold. A very pale, mint-green screen with openings across the top stands to the left behind the second woman, and a window is behind the first. Spiky fronds of a houseplant angle up toward the sunlight, and a coral-pink curtain is pulled to the left side. Squiggles and flowers printed in rust red suggest a pattern on white curtains covering the window and the pink curtain to the left. The wall behind the screen is straw yellow. The artist signed and inscribed the sheet under the lower right corner, “Imprimée par l'artiste et M. Leroy, Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves) serie unique.” A tiny dark blue stamp with a short, wide C overlaid on a capital letter M is inked along the bottom edge of the image, and writing in graphite in the lower left corner of the sheet reads, “E 9539 set of 10 – n 3.”

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: A pale-skinned woman, nude from the waist up, gathers her hair in her raised hands as she sits before a mirror in this vertical, colored print. The large mirror is to our right, and the woman’s body is mostly turned away from us. Her head is bowed but a loose tendril of brown hair hanging beside one cheek is reflected in the mirror. Her lower body is wrapped in a voluminous off-white cloth as she leans forward on a curved terracotta-red and white striped armchair. Her facial features, the contours of her body, and the folds of the towel are all delineated with thin strokes of tawny brown. The mirror is set into a tan wall, and the wall beyond and carpet below her covered with abstract floral patterns. The wall has a dusty-rose motif over lighter pink background while the carpet pattern is tan against muted dark pink background. The wall and chair are reflected in the mirror in paler tones. A mark with an oval, or a mirrored C, over an uppercase M, is stamped in royal blue at the bottom center of the print. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Imprimée par l’artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves)."

artworks.title: The Up-Tide on the Avenue
artworks.medium: black and gray wash with white heightening
artworks.description: This is a painting of a horse-drawn carriage on a rainy day in an urban environment. Wet cobblestones reflect the overcast sky as the horse stands still, attached to a two-wheeled carriage. Umbrellas can be seen in the scene, suggesting light rain, with blurred figures walking past. The play of shadows and atmospheric effects is typical of street life in the city. The painting features a monochromatic palette of deep browns and blacks, giving it a moody and realistic tone.

artworks.title: Leopold I and Eleanor of Austria
artworks.description: This image shows two people from the chest up in formal poses. The person on the left has long, curly hair and a mustache, wearing an elaborate coat with fine embroidery near the collar. This person has a pointed nose, narrow eyes, and full lips. The person on the right has similarly styled curly hair pulled back, and wears an ornate necklace. Details include large eyes, a nose, and lips. The clothing features intricate lacework and a prominent brooch. Both wear jewelry, including earrings on the woman. The background has detailed scrollwork and decorative script framing both faces.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in pink, brown, and yellow on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a crucifixion scene with a central figure on the cross with the inscription "INRI" above them. Flanking the crucifixion are two standing figures and one kneeling figure at the foot of the cross. The scene is enclosed within a simple architectural frame with columns on the sides and decorative elements at the top corners. The background features plant motifs, indicating an outdoor setting. The style is reminiscent of medieval religious woodcut prints, with strong outlines and minimal color.

artworks.title: The Trinity
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in vermilion, lilac, and ochre on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure wearing a crown and robe, holding a crucifix with a figure on it. The figure has a beard and long hair visible under the crown. They sit on a throne with two winged figures leaning towards them. The throne has intricate design with red and brown accents. The background features architectural elements and decorative patterns. The palette is warm with red, beige, and brown tones.

artworks.title: Saint Dominic
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, vermilion, orange, blue, olive, and ochre
artworks.dimensions:
image: 27.3 x 10.8 cm (10 3/4 x 4 1/4 in.)
sheet: 29.1 x 14 cm (11 7/16 x 5 1/2 in.)
overall (external frame dimensions): 59.7 x 44.5 cm (23 1/2 x 17 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a frontal position. He has a halo around his head, short, straight hair, a beard and mustache. He wears a long robe and holds a long cross with a figure of Christ on it and a small church structure. The background has two sections: the man in front of pillars with draped fabric, and an upper scene with figures in a domestic setting near a bed. The image is rendered in a style resembling a medieval or early religious art illustration on aged paper.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman at Market
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman standing in profile facing right. She is shown holding a bundle of vegetables in her left hand and a long-handled tool in her right hand. She is wearing traditional attire and a scarf covering her head. Various items such as a basket, wooden tub, and jug are seen around her. A swirling banner with text is in the background.

artworks.title: Peasant at Market
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing. He is facing left and depicted in profile. The man has a pronounced nose and chin, with short hair tucked under a rounded hat adorned with a small leaf. He wears a long-sleeved tunic with a belt, trousers, and knee-high boots. In one hand, he holds a large sword, and in the other hand, a staff-like object. He carries a large horn-like instrument on his back. Various objects surround him, including a jug and a sack with a stick. In the background is a looping banner with the text "DETEN WIR VERKAUFFEN".

artworks.title: January and February
artworks.description: The image depicts two pairs of individuals walking side by side. The left pair consists of a man and woman walking to the left, while the right pair consists of another man and woman walking to the right. The individuals are dressed in historical clothing, including fur hats, coats, scarves, long dresses, skirts, belts, and boots. The men are depicted with distinctive profiles, prominent noses, and strong features, while the women have their hair tied and appear slightly hunched. The men seem to be holding objects at their belts. The background is a textured ground, suggesting an outdoor setting. Text above each pair identifies them as Fabians Jänner and Mathias Hornung from the year 1546.

artworks.title: March and April
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a vintage, detailed sketch, walking from left to right. The first person is a woman in a long dress with a headscarf, holding leafy branches. Next to her is a man in a long coat, knee-length breeches, and a hat, gesturing with his right hand. Following them is another woman in a similar dress with a cape and headscarf, with clasped hands. Beside her is a man in a knee-length coat, fitted trousers, and a brimmed hat with a feather, marching forward. The background is blank.

artworks.title: May and June
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in motion. The figures are dressed in period attire with tunics and hats. Each individual is dynamically posed. The drawing features textured lines and shading for depth and detail. The text above each pair identifies them, possibly suggesting names. The drawing is in a horizontal format.

artworks.title: July and August
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures interacting. The scene depicts four characters in traditional attire engaged in a dynamic scene. On the left, a pair is in a lively stance with arms raised and feet positioned as if in motion. On the right, one figure has hands clasped and the other has a hand resting on a sword sheath. The characters are dressed in garments suggesting a medieval or renaissance European setting, complete with hats and robes. There are inscriptions above the figures and a date of 1546 in the center, along with the initials ISB. The drawing showcases fine line work and stippling to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: September and October
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures dressed in historical attire engaged in dynamic action. Two figures on the left are in a confrontational pose, while the figure on the right is carrying a sword. On the right side, two figures appear to be interacting, with one holding a long pole and the other wearing robes and a laurel crown. The scene is detailed, with the characters standing on grass tufts.

artworks.title: November and December
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in line drawing style. Two figures are a man and woman walking left, while the other two are a man and woman on the right. The woman on the left holds the man's hand, wearing a long dress. The man next to her wears a cloak. The woman on the right holds a basket, dressed in a belted long-sleeved dress with a cap. The man on the right is bent forward, wearing a tunic and laurel wreath. The background is plain with some grass detail beneath the figures.

artworks.title: The Year's End
artworks.description: In the image, there are four individuals depicted from left to right. The first person is in motion, wearing a jester's hat and medieval-style clothing, holding a sheathed sword. The second person, a woman, is pulling the first person and holding a bag. Next to them are two musicians playing a wind instrument and a bagpipe. The background features a tree and some structures, with scripted text at the top.

artworks.title: Peasants' Feast
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 x 7.2 cm (1 15/16 x 2 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows seven individuals gathered around a wooden table. The setting appears to be a vineyard with grape vines in the background. Each person is dressed in elaborate historical clothing. Some individuals are seated while others are standing. The group appears to be interacting around the table, with raised cups and gestures of speaking or toasting. Above them is a scroll with text. The drawing includes detailed lines and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Peasants' Brawl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.9 x 7.3 cm (1 15/16 x 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork shows four figures fighting in a rural setting, with a vineyard in the background. Each figure is armed with weapons like swords and a club. The characters are detailed, with expressive gestures and muscular anatomy. A banner with script is above them. The artwork features intricate line work and shading for a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: Peasants Behind the Fence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a rural setting. The artwork shows three figures in the foreground. On the left, two figures are entangled in an embrace or interaction, with a third figure overseeing from above. In the middle, a figure appears to be engaging in conversation, gesturing with one hand. The composition is set against a background of a fence with twisted branches and sparse vegetation, reflecting an outdoor setting. The style is highly detailed with strong outlines, characteristic of print works in the manner of the Renaissance period. The text above the figures is in German.

artworks.title: The Lady and the Fool
artworks.description: The image depicts two people standing closely together in an affectionate pose. The person on the left has a bearded face and is wearing a hat with a point and a tassel. They have their left arm wrapped around the waist of the other person. The person on the right is wearing long sleeves adorned with lace or frills. Both individuals are wearing historical attire typical of the early 16th century. The person in front is holding a handful of flowers. The background shows a simple fence or railing, along with potted plants and stylized flowers, suggesting a garden setting.

artworks.title: Hungry Dogs, second stone
artworks.description: This is a drawing of dogs scavenging near a trash can in an urban alleyway. The dogs are depicted rummaging through the refuse in a sketchy style. In the foreground, a tipped-over trash can is surrounded by scattered waste. The background is dimly lit, creating a gritty atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, trees, distant buildings, and cows grazing and resting near the water. The painting has a calm and peaceful atmosphere, with delicate brushwork and warm, muted tones of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: The Farmyard
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a thatched-roofed building as the central focus. The horizon is suggested by the treeline and the building's roof. The artwork features fine brushstrokes or etching lines for texture, particularly evident in the roof, trees, and grassy areas. The color palette is monochromatic, using dark brown or sepia tones. Additionally, a rider on horseback and scattered sheep are visible in the foreground. Figures near a house entrance are engaging in an activity, while more figures are scattered throughout the scene alongside trees, providing a sense of activity in the countryside setting.
